data.name: Dadabhoy Cement Industries Limited
data.description: Dadabhoy Cement Industries Limited (DCIL) was incorporated on 09 August 1 979 as a public limited company. Company is a subsidiary of Leo (Pvt.) Limited. The Company is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of ordinary portland, slag and sulphate resistant cement.
